If forced to choose between the two options in the team note, I'd pick **C**: it reaches the right verdict (not guilty), but its stated reason is wrong because arson is a felony. I can't endorse **A**, since nothing in the facts shows he consciously disregarded a known risk while asleep and intoxicated, so at most he was negligent. My original answer, D, gives the reasoning I still think is correct, but it isn't one of the options the team note lists.

CONFIDENCE: 55
